metadata.question: Was the aerosol optical depth higher over the Gobi Desert in February 2020 than in February 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS MAIAC AOD (MODIS/006/MCD19A2) over a broad Gobi Desert polygon (90E-116E, 37N-46N). Compare February 2019 (2019-02-01 to 2019-03-01) and February 2020 (2020-02-01 to 2020-03-01). If a month has zero images, widen by ±7 days to attempt recovery.
2. Masking strategy: Use MAIAC quality (AOD_QA ≤ 1) and valid AOD range 0–5 to mask. This targets higher-quality retrievals; clouds and poor retrievals are masked by QA.
3. Logic for Valid Zero vs Null/Error: 
   - If image collection still empty after widening → C1.
   - If valid pixel count after masking is 0 → C2.
   - If mean AOD is null/NaN or outside [0,5] → C3.
   - Otherwise compare: if 2020 mean > 2019 mean → A, else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helpers
  function getInfo(obj) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      obj.getInfo((res, err) => {
        if (err) reject(err);
        else resolve(res);
      });
    });
  }

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  const gobi = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
    [[[90.0, 46.0], [116.0, 46.0], [116.0, 37.0], [90.0, 37.0], [90.0, 46.0]]],
    null,
    false
  );
  const scale = 3000;

  // 2. Data Acquisition & Masking
  function maskMAIAC(img) {
    const aod = img.select('Optical_Depth_055');
    const qa = img.select('AOD_QA');
    const good = qa.lte(1).and(aod.gte(0)).and(aod.lte(5));
    return img.updateMask(good).select(['Optical_Depth_055']).copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']);
  }

  function getCol(start, end) {
    return ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD19A2')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(gobi)
      .map(maskMAIAC);
  }

  async function computePeriodStats(label, startStr, endStr) {
    let start = ee.Date(startStr);
    let end = ee.Date(endStr);
    let col = getCol(start, end);
    let size = await getInfo(col.size());
    let widened = false;
    if (size === 0) {
      widened = true;
      col = getCol(start.advance(-7, 'day'), end.advance(7, 'day'));
      size = await getInfo(col.size());
    }
    console.log(`${label} Images: ${size}${widened ? ' (widened)' : ''}`);
    if (size === 0) {
      return { code: 'C1' };
    }

    const band = 'Optical_Depth_055';
    const meanImg = col.select(band).mean().clip(gobi);

    // Pixel counts
    const totalCount = await getInfo(
      ee.Image(1).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: gobi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
        bestEffort: true
      }).get('constant')
    );
    const validCount = await getInfo(
      ee.Image(1).updateMask(meanImg.mask()).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: gobi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
        bestEffort: true
      }).get('constant')
    );
    if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
      console.log(`${label} Valid pixels: 0 / ${totalCount} (0%)`);
      return { code: 'C2' };
    }
    console.log(`${label} Valid pixels: ${validCount} / ${totalCount} (${(validCount / totalCount * 100).toFixed(1)}%)`);

    const meanVal = await getInfo(
      meanImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: gobi,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
        bestEffort: true
      }).get(band)
    );

    if (meanVal === null || !isFinite(meanVal) || isNaN(meanVal) || meanVal < 0 || meanVal > 5) {
      return { code: 'C3' };
    }
    console.log(`${label} Mean AOD: ${Number(meanVal).toFixed(3)}`);
    return { code: 'OK', mean: Number(meanVal) };
  }

  try {
    const feb2019 = await computePeriodStats('Feb 2019', '2019-02-01', '2019-03-01');
    const feb2020 = await computePeriodStats('Feb 2020', '2020-02-01', '2020-03-01');

    // Error precedence handling
    if (feb2019.code === 'C1' || feb2020.code === 'C1') {
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if (feb2019.code === 'C2' || feb2020.code === 'C2') {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (feb2019.code === 'C3' || feb2020.code === 'C3') {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const diff = feb2020.mean - feb2019.mean;
    console.log(`Delta AOD (2020-2019): ${diff.toFixed(3)}`);
    if (diff > 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(`Error: ${e}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
